text:
sophie: Quick heads-up — FinPlus wants an air-gapped POC in their gov VPC. Main asks: 1) offline bundle delivery (sideload/USB), 2) activation without outbound (license file), 3) patch cadence limited to once/week max, 4) cert rotation handled offline. Anyone taken this through tech + legal recently? @raj?

raj: We shipped something similar for BankX last Q. High-level options: full immutable bundle (single tarball) vs delta minibundles for patches. For once/week cadence, minibundles + signed deltas work. Legal will want an activation artifact flow rather than a long-lived token.

maria: Tech gotchas: our quantized weights + runtime require kernel compatibility. We can produce a signed bundle with SBOM and a detached signature. Activation flow we used before looked like: 
```
$ redwood-offline-activate --bundle /media/usb/finplus-v1.tar.gz --license /media/usb/license.json 
Activation complete. token: <redacted>
```
That blob is stored locally; no egress required. For cert rotation offline, we ship a rotation playbook and a small tool to rotate the TLS certs and re-sign artifacts.

avery: Pricing question from the account — they want metered billing but no outbound telemetry. Options? charge a committed monthly quota for Dedicated onprem, or collect usage reports that they push on reconnect (customer-sent upload). Both have tradeoffs for auditability. Are we ok with a commit + reconcile model?

neil (legal): Need to update SOW/EULA for offline activation. Key items: chain-of-custody for USB media, escrow clause for signing keys, indemnity for customer-applied patches, and acceptance criteria for "successful activation". Also confirm export controls on model artifacts.

sean-bot: artifact build finished — bundle `finplus-v1.tar.gz` sha256: `3f7a9b2c8d1e4a6b9f8d2c4b6a1e3c9d7f5a2b1c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9` (signed).

raj: For the POC BOM I'll include: signed bundle, SBOM, cert rotation tool, offline activator, license.json template, patch minibundles, and a 1-page install + rollback runbook. On metering: recommend commit-based pricing for POC, with an optional usage uploader for reconciliation at cutover.

sophie: Sounds good. Next steps: I’ll take legal checklist to FinPlus on Wed 10am PT. Raj — can you draft the POC BOM + one-page install/runbook by EOD Fri? Maria — can you confirm runtime kernel compatibility matrix and a short note on quantization constraints? Neil — I'll attach the SOW checklist for your review. :pray:

avery: Also to capture — FinPlus asked if we support HSM-signed activation files (they want HSM on their side). Is that supported or do we need to coordinate key-exchange?

raj: HSM on customer side is fine; we support detached signatures. Will add HSM notes to BOM.

sophie: Thanks all — I'll update the customer after Wed sync. :thumbsup:
